name: Hotel Marques de Riscal
insider_take: This Frank Gehry-designed architectural masterpiece rises like a metallic sculpture from ancient vineyards, where avant-garde luxury meets 160 years of winemaking tradition in Spain's prestigious Rioja region.
whats_special: The hotel's striking titanium and steel facade mirrors the colors of Marqués de Riscal wine capsules, while the property sits directly on the historic winery estate founded in 1858. Guests enjoy exclusive access to century-old cellars housing over 3 million bottles and can participate in private harvest experiences during vendimia season.
pro_tip: Book the Marqués de Riscal suite for panoramic vineyard views and complimentary wine tastings, then time your visit during October harvest season to witness traditional grape-picking alongside local vintners.
dont_miss: The Vinothérapie Spa by Caudalie offers wine-based treatments using grape extracts, while the Michelin-starred restaurant showcases innovative Basque cuisine paired with exclusive Riscal vintages. The nearby medieval village of Laguardia, just 6km away, features underground wine caves dating back to the 12th century.
pros: Iconic Frank Gehry architectural design with stunning titanium facade
World-renowned winery location with premium wine experiences
Michelin-starred dining at Restaurant Marqués de Riscal
Luxurious Vinothérapie spa treatments using wine-based therapies
cons: Remote location in Rioja wine country requiring transportation
Premium pricing reflecting luxury positioning and unique design
